whyItMatters: java credentials compare against source literals (password.equals("s3cret-x")), which leak through checkouts and builds.
actions: Load the expected value from a secret manager or KDF-verified hash and compare in constant time.
Rotate the literal that was committed.
Re-run the scan and confirm no literal comparison remains outside tests.
verification: Rescan shows no literal comparison outside tests, and rotation is complete.
